title: How long?
note: Written fresh on 2026-11-26 at James's word: "I want you to have liberty to write the scripts." Not recorded, and James has not read it yet. Every fact is listed with where to check it in facts.md beside this file. Scripture is the Berean Standard Bible, copied word for word from client/public/bible/text/; an exclamation mark appears only where the verse has one. Field names and `gap` follow James's description of the Gather scripts; match them to film/beliefs/script.json on the Mac.

lines: Some people think faith means never complaining to God. The Bible disagrees.
How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

scripture.text: How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?

lines: That's a prayer. It's in the Bible's own prayer book, and it isn't alone. More psalms sound like this than any other kind.
And they follow a path. Turn to God. Tell him what's wrong, plainly. Ask him to act. Then choose to trust him.
Watch David make that turn. Nothing around him has changed yet.
But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

scripture.text: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.

lines: Lament isn't the opposite of faith. It's what faith sounds like when it hurts.
You can bring him the whole truth. He already knows it.
